reviewer.name: Codex RC9 published Mac visual review

observations.name: signed-chat.png
observations.observation: RC9 footer visible; 52px header with named bot and Bot settings action. Assistant bubbles and composer share the left edge after sidebar closure. Details links sit below bubbles; composer remains within the window with no overlap.

observations.name: signed-bot-settings.png
observations.observation: Bot settings opens directly to active Settings tab in right sidebar. Model roles and appearance are grouped in bordered sections; message column and composer contract to the same width. No clipping of names or selectors.

observations.name: signed-bot-overview.png
observations.observation: Overview displays bot identity, bound folder and empty active-task state before compact policy information. Long fixture path is contained with ellipsis; sidebar close control and tabs stay visible.

observations.name: signed-bot-memory.png
observations.observation: Memory filters align in the sidebar; three saved synthetic entries have rectangular cards, consistent radii, SVG disclosures and readable actions. Pagination remains at the sidebar footer, without covering the composer.

limits: Synthetic history and memory; no live model response acceptance
